items.title: Special termination right due to gas price increase
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to terminate without notice effective 01.01.2027 ('zum 01.01.2027 zu kündigen'), the date the new prices take effect. For the termination to be effective, the cancellation must reach the provider before that date ('vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen'). The new prices take effect on 2027-01-01, so the last day the cancellation may arrive is the day before, 2026-12-31. This is a fixed contractual deadline tied to a calendar date, not a statutory period subject to § 193 BGB weekend/holiday extension, and 2026-12-31 is a Thursday (a working day) in any case, so no adjustment is needed.
